_howto: Paste your Google Form (or Tally/Typeform) links into each interestUrl. While a link is empty, the button shows 'Opening soon'. Change price, dates and groupSize whenever you decide.

walks.title: Singapore Scent Walks
walks.tagline: Smell the city with a guide
walks.intro: Small-group walks through the places behind Singapore's notes: jasmine garlands, attar shops, Raffles' spice garden and temple incense. Every stop comes with the history behind the scent.

options.name: The Kampong Gelam & Little India walk

included: A guide who tells the story behind every stop
Smelling samples of the raw notes along the way
A printed note card for each scent you meet
notIncluded: Workshop fees, if you add a perfume-making session

set.title: Singapore in Six Scents
set.tagline: A discovery set of local perfumes
set.intro: Six sample vials from Singapore perfume houses, each paired with a card telling the history of its key note. A souvenir you can actually smell.
set.status: Proposed line-up. Brand partnerships are not confirmed yet.
inTheBox: A fold-out map of the one-day scent trail

business.title: Scent storytelling for businesses
business.intro: Hotels, airlines and brands already invest in signature scents. I help them root those scents in real local culture, using consumer insight and sourced history.

services.name: Cultural scent briefs
services.what: A researched brief linking your brand or place to local notes and their history, ready to hand to a perfumer or fragrance house.

services.name: Heritage scent trails for teams
services.what: Private guided scent walks for team-building, client hosting or offsites, with optional perfume-making.

services.name: Scent and trend insight
services.what: Research on which notes local brands use, which they don't, and what that suggests about consumers.

proof.text: Singapore Airlines' signature scent, Batik Flora, was built from six flowers in its batik motif, with local label Scent by SIX.
Local brand Lynk Fragrances co-created signature scents for MRT stations with SBS Transit.
For SG60, dsm-firmenich and the Singapore Botanic Gardens created Singapore Eco Orchid from living orchids.

business.about: I'm Suki: a psychology graduate with a background in consumer insight and foresight in the fragrance and flavour industry, now building Scent Atlas.
